q.en: If an algorithm is Θ(n), is it also O(n²)?
q.zh: 若算法为 Θ(n)，它也属于 O(n²) 吗？

a.en: Yes, for n≥1 a linear bound is also quadratic. Θ(n) is the more informative tight statement.
a.zh: 是。n≥1 时，线性上界也是二次上界；Θ(n) 是更有信息的紧确陈述。

q.en: Why is the running total initially correct?
q.zh: 为什么初始运行和正确？

a.en: Before reading any values, the sum of the empty prefix is 0. The variable also starts at 0.
a.zh: 还未读取值时，空前缀之和为 0，变量也从 0 开始。

q.en: What happens when the third input, 6, arrives?
q.zh: 第三项 6 到来时发生什么？

a.en: The old total is 3. Adding 6 gives 9. This equals the sum of the first three values: 4 + (−1) + 6.

q.en: Does a single fast run prove a linear bound?
q.zh: 一次快速运行能证明线性界吗？

a.en: No. A timing measures one situation. Counting one addition per input explains the linear bound for every input of that length.
a.zh: 不能。计时只测一个情境；每输入一项做一次加法，才解释所有同长度输入的线性界。

q.en: Which representation is a natural fit for millions of random indexed reads and rare middle insertions?
q.zh: 数百万次随机索引读取、中间插入很少，适合哪种表示？

a.en: An array-based list, because direct indexing is constant time and its occasional shifting cost may be acceptable.
a.zh: 数组列表，因为直接索引为常数，偶尔的移动成本可能可以接受。

q.en: Why does inserting at array index 1 shift three items here?
q.zh: 为何在数组索引 1 插入需要移动三项？

a.en: In [L, M, N, P], M, N and P must each move one position to leave room for X.
a.zh: [L,M,N,P] 中 M、N、P 各右移一个位置，为 X 留空间。

q.en: Why save old_next before changing m.next?
q.zh: 修改 m.next 前为何保存 old_next？

a.en: It keeps access to the rest of the chain. Without that reference, replacing the link could disconnect later nodes.
a.zh: 保留到后续链的访问路径，否则替换链接可能断开后续节点。

q.en: Is a linked-list insertion always O(1)?
q.zh: 链表插入总是 O(1) 吗？

a.en: Only the link change at a known place is O(1). Walking to that place may take O(n).
a.zh: 只有已知位置上的链接修改是 O(1)，走到该位置可能为 O(n)。

q.en: Why does the bracket string ([)] fail despite equal counts of openers and closers?
q.zh: 为什么 ([)] 左右括号数量相等却失败？

a.en: The first closer ) does not match the current stack top [. Correct nesting requires matching the most recent unmatched opener.
a.zh: 第一个右括号 ) 不匹配当前栈顶 [。正确嵌套要求匹配最近未匹配的左括号。

q.en: Why does a stack reject ([)]?
q.zh: 为什么栈拒绝 ([)]？

a.en: When ) arrives, [ is still on top. Counts alone cannot detect this wrong nesting order.
a.zh: 当 ) 到来时，[ 仍在栈顶。只计数量发现不了嵌套次序错误。

q.en: What does deque.popleft remove?
q.zh: deque.popleft 移除什么？

a.en: It removes the leftmost item. If new items were appended on the right, this is the oldest item.
a.zh: 移除最左项。若新项在右端追加，这就是最早项。

q.en: Why keep size in a circular queue?
q.zh: 环形队列为何保存 size？

a.en: The same front and back positions can occur when a ring is empty or full. A size value makes the state clear.
a.zh: 空和满可能拥有相同前后位置，size 让状态明确。

q.en: Which traversal naturally deletes an entire tree when children must be removed before their parent?
q.zh: 删除整树时若必须先删孩子后删父亲，哪种遍历自然？

a.en: Postorder, because each subtree is processed before the node that owns it.
a.zh: 后序，因为拥有子树的节点最后处理。

q.en: Why does postorder help compute size?
q.zh: 后序为何适合计算大小？

a.en: A parent needs its child sizes first. Postorder completes those calculations before combining them.
a.zh: 父节点先需要孩子大小，后序先算完孩子再合并。

q.en: What is the height of a single-node tree?
q.zh: 单节点树高度是多少？

a.en: It is 0 under the edge-count convention. There is no downward edge to travel.
a.zh: 按边计为 0，没有向下的边。

q.en: Is inorder always sorted?
q.zh: 中序总是有序吗？

a.en: No. It follows a structural order. Sorted output also requires the binary-search-tree key invariant.
a.zh: 不是。它只是结构顺序，还需 BST 键不变量才有序。

q.en: What happens if increasing keys are inserted into an ordinary empty BST?
q.zh: 递增键依次插入普通空 BST 会怎样？

a.en: They form a rightward chain, giving linear height and linear worst-case lookup despite the BST ordering invariant.
a.zh: 形成向右的链，高度与最坏查找为线性，虽然仍满足 BST 顺序。

q.en: Why can search skip the left branch after seeing 18 when looking for 22?
q.zh: 查 22 看到 18 后为何能跳过左边？

a.en: Every key in that left branch is smaller than 18. None can be 22.
a.zh: 左子树全部小于 18，不可能是 22。

q.en: What does a query for [10,28] return here?

a.en: It returns 13, 18, 22 and 27. Both query endpoints are included if they are stored.
a.zh: 13、18、22、27；若端点存在也会包含。

q.en: What happens if increasing keys are inserted without balancing?
q.zh: 递增插入且不平衡会怎样？

a.en: They form a rightward chain. Search may inspect every node, so its worst-case cost becomes O(n).
a.zh: 形成右链，搜索可能检查全部节点，最坏成本 O(n)。

q.en: Does a rotation change the sorted order returned by inorder traversal?
q.zh: 旋转改变中序返回的排序顺序吗？

a.en: No. A correct rotation rearranges parent relationships while preserving the relative inorder sequence of all keys and attached subtrees.
a.zh: 不改变。正确旋转调整父子关系，但保留全部键及附属子树的相对中序。

q.en: Why is 30 unbalanced before rotating 30–20–10?
q.zh: 30–20–10 旋转前为何 30 不平衡？

a.en: Its left child has height 1 and its missing right child has height −1. Their difference is 2.
a.zh: 左孩子高 1，缺失右孩子高 −1，差为 2。

q.en: Why update the old root before the new root?
q.zh: 为何先更新旧根再新根？

a.en: The new root's height depends on the repaired old root. Using the old height could store a wrong result.
a.zh: 新根高度依赖修好的旧根，使用旧高度会记录错误结果。

q.en: Does one successful rotation finish every AVL deletion?
q.zh: 一次成功旋转能结束所有 AVL 删除吗？

a.en: No. The repaired branch can become shorter, making another ancestor unbalanced. Continue checking upward.
a.zh: 不能。修好分支可能变矮，使更高祖先不平衡，必须继续向上检查。

q.en: Why swap a sinking element with the smaller child in a min-heap?
q.zh: 小顶堆下沉时为何交换较小孩子？

a.en: Using the larger child could leave that parent larger than its other child, violating heap order immediately.
a.zh: 若用较大孩子，新父值可能大于另一个孩子，立即违反堆序。

q.en: Why can index 0 hold a minimum without sorting all other entries?
q.zh: 为什么不全排序也能让索引 0 为最小？

a.en: Every downward step is nondecreasing by the parent rule. No descendant can be smaller than the root.
a.zh: 沿每条向下路径值都不减，所以后代不可能小于根。

q.en: Which parent does an item at index 5 compare with?
q.zh: 索引 5 与哪个父亲比较？

a.en: Its parent index is (5−1)//2 = 2.

q.en: Why choose the smaller child during downward repair?
q.zh: 为何下沉选择较小孩子？

a.en: The replacement parent must be no larger than both children. Swapping with the larger child could leave the smaller child above it in priority.
a.zh: 替换后的父值必须不大于两个孩子；换较大孩子可能把较小孩子留在父值之下。

q.en: Why can insertion sort be useful for small or nearly sorted arrays despite its worst-case bound?
q.zh: 插入排序最坏很慢，为什么仍适合小数组或近乎有序数组？

a.en: Its control overhead is small and work tracks inversions. Few inversions mean few shifts, so the worst-case quadratic pattern may not arise.
a.zh: 控制开销小，工作随逆序对数变化。逆序少就移动少，不一定出现二次最坏情况。

q.en: Why shift right before writing the new value?
q.zh: 为什么先右移再写新值？

a.en: The shifts make an empty position while preserving every larger value. Writing first could overwrite a value that is still needed.
a.zh: 移动保留较大值并留下空位，先写可能覆盖尚需保留的值。

q.en: Why are there five shifts for [5,2,4,1]?

a.en: The steps shift 1, then 1, then 3 values. These five shifts match the five original inverted pairs.
a.zh: 各轮移动 1、1、3 项，总计五次，正好是五个原逆序。

q.en: Is a heapq-based result list an in-place heap sort?
q.zh: heapq 结果列表是原地堆排序吗？

a.en: No. It uses another list for the answers. The time can still be O(n log n), but extra storage is O(n).
a.zh: 不是，它另存答案。时间仍可 O(n log n)，额外空间是 O(n)。

q.en: Why does changing table capacity usually require rehashing existing keys?
q.zh: 为何改变容量通常必须重哈希已有键？

a.en: The compression into bucket indices depends on capacity, so old positions may no longer lie on each key’s correct lookup path.
a.zh: 压缩到桶索引的规则依赖容量，原位置可能不再位于该键正确搜索路径上。

q.en: Why do 10, 17 and 24 collide modulo 7?

a.en: Each leaves remainder 3. A collision is normal and does not mean the keys are equal.
a.zh: 它们余数都为 3。碰撞正常，不表示键相等。

q.en: Why can search pass a tombstone but stop at None?
q.zh: 为何能越过墓碑却在 None 停止？

a.en: Here None means the slot was never occupied. A tombstone means a displaced key may still lie farther along the probe route.
a.zh: 此处 None 表示槽从未占用，墓碑表示被推移的键可能仍在后方。

q.en: Does doubling the number of buckets guarantee constant-time search?
q.zh: 桶数翻倍能保证常数查找吗？

a.en: No. Keys could still collide badly. The expected bound also needs suitable hash-distribution assumptions.
a.zh: 不能，键仍可严重碰撞，期望界还需要合适哈希分布。

q.en: If a multiset map stores {x:4,y:2}, how many distinct elements and total occurrences are present?
q.zh: 多重集合 {x:4,y:2} 有多少种元素和总出现次数？

a.en: Two distinct elements and six occurrences. These are different size measures and should be named explicitly.
a.zh: 两种元素、六次出现。这是不同大小指标，应明确命名。

q.en: Where does key 0 go when key 3 takes its first slot?
q.zh: 键 3 取代第一槽时，键 0 去哪里？

a.en: Key 0 moves from first[0] to second[0], its other allowed location.
a.zh: 0 从 first[0] 移到 second[0]，即另一允许位置。

q.en: Why is a move limit necessary?
q.zh: 为何需要移动上限？

a.en: A sequence of evictions can cycle. A full implementation must rebuild rather than keep moving forever.
a.zh: 逐出可能循环，完整实现需重建而不是永远移动。

q.en: How do set and Counter treat red, blue, red?
q.zh: set 与 Counter 怎样处理 red、blue、red？

a.en: A set keeps two distinct colors. Counter keeps red:2 and blue:1, for three total occurrences.
a.zh: set 保留两色；Counter 保存 red:2、blue:1，总出现三次。

q.en: Which representation is usually preferable for traversing a very sparse graph?
q.zh: 遍历极稀疏图通常适合什么表示？

a.en: Adjacency lists, because they store and scan actual edges in O(n+m) total space and traversal work.
a.zh: 邻接表只存和扫描真实边，总空间与遍历工作 O(n+m)。

q.en: Why is each corridor added to two neighbor lists?
q.zh: 为什么走廊加入两个邻居表？

a.en: The corridor is undirected. From either endpoint, the other endpoint must be reachable in one step.
a.zh: 走廊无向，从任一端都必须一步到另一端。

q.en: Why do the degrees add to 8?
q.zh: 度数为何总和 8？

a.en: The four corridors each contribute two endpoint entries, giving 2×4=8.
a.zh: 四条走廊各贡献两个端点项，2×4=8。

q.en: Why is this five-vertex, four-edge graph not a tree?
q.zh: 五顶点四边图为何不是树？

a.en: A, B, D and C form a cycle, and E is isolated. The edge count does not replace a connectivity check.
a.zh: A、B、D、C 成环，E 孤立。边数不能代替连通检查。

q.en: Why is the bridge condition strict rather than low[v]≥disc[u]?
q.zh: 为何用严格 > 而非 ≥？

a.en: Equality means the subtree can reconnect directly to u through another route, forming a cycle and protecting the tree edge from being a bridge.
a.zh: 相等表示子树可经另一条路线直接回到 u，形成环并保护树边。

q.en: Why is C–D a bridge?
q.zh: C–D 为何是桥？

a.en: D has no edge back to C or earlier vertices except the edge used to enter D. Removing C–D isolates D.
a.zh: 除进入 D 的边外，D 无边回到 C 或更早顶点，移除就隔离 D。

q.en: Why does low[C] become 0?
q.zh: low[C] 为何变零？

a.en: C has a nonparent edge to A, whose discovery number is 0.
a.zh: C 有到 A 的非父边，A 的发现编号为零。

q.en: Can we skip every edge to the parent in a graph with parallel edges?
q.zh: 平行边图可跳过全部指向父的边吗？

a.en: No. A second parallel edge is an alternate connection. Track edge identifiers and skip only the exact entering edge.
a.zh: 不可，第二条平行边是替代连接，应追踪边编号，只跳过确切进入边。

q.en: If every edge has weight seven, can BFS still find a minimum-weight path?
q.zh: 所有边权都为七，BFS 能找最小权路线吗？

a.en: Yes. Minimizing edge count also minimizes total weight 7 times that count because all edges have the same positive weight.
a.zh: 能。总权为边数乘共同正权七，最少边数也最小化权重。

q.en: Why mark E when it enters the queue?
q.zh: 为何 E 入队时就标记？

a.en: Later, another neighbor may also see E. The mark prevents duplicate queue entries and keeps one parent choice.
a.zh: 另一个邻居也可能看到 E，标记防止重复队列项，并保留一个父选择。

q.en: Why is E at distance 3 in the example?
q.zh: E 为何距离 3？

a.en: A route S–A–C–E uses three edges, and BFS checks every shorter layer before discovering E.
a.zh: S–A–C–E 用三边，发现 E 前 BFS 已检查全部更短层。

q.en: What if a one-edge route costs 20 minutes and a two-edge route costs 2?
q.zh: 一边路线花 20 分钟，两边路线花 2 分钟怎么办？

a.en: BFS chooses fewer edges, not less time. Use an algorithm for weighted paths, such as Dijkstra when weights are nonnegative.
a.zh: BFS 选边少而非时间少，应使用加权路径算法，例如非负权的 Dijkstra。

q.en: Why not place the second exit into the queue only after finishing the first search?
q.zh: 为什么不能等第一个出口搜索结束后，再加入第二个出口？

a.en: Cells would already be marked with distances to the first exit. Without resetting or relaxing them, the second wave cannot improve those distances. Seed the whole source set first.
a.zh: 格子已被标上到第一个出口的距离。若不重置或松弛，第二股波无法改善结果，所以应先放入整个源点集合。

q.en: Does Dijkstra require distinct positive edge weights?
q.zh: Dijkstra 要求权重各不相同且严格为正吗？

a.en: No. Equal weights and zero weights are valid. All weights must be nonnegative for the standard correctness guarantee.
a.zh: 不，等权和零权都有效；标准正确性保证要求全部非负。

q.en: Why does A improve from 6 to 3?
q.zh: A 为何从 6 改为 3？

a.en: The route S→B costs 2, and B→A costs 1. Together they cost 3, which is smaller than 6.
a.zh: S→B 成本 2，B→A 成本 1，共 3，小于 6。

q.en: Why skip the heap entry (6,A)?
q.zh: 为何跳过 (6,A)？

a.en: A already has distance 3. Processing its old value repeats work and no longer represents the current best route.
a.zh: A 已有距离 3，处理旧值重复工作且不代表当前最好路线。

q.en: Does a negative edge always make the answer wrong?
q.zh: 负边一定让答案错误吗？

a.en: Not necessarily on every input, but it removes the proof that a settled label is final. Use an algorithm designed for negative weights instead.
a.zh: 并非每个输入都错，但失去定点距离为最终值的证明，应使用为负权设计的算法。

q.en: Does every negative edge create a negative cycle?
q.zh: 有负权边就一定存在负环吗？

a.en: No. A cycle must return to its start, and its total weight must be negative. A single edge A->B with weight -2 does not establish either condition.
a.zh: 不是。环必须回到起点，而且总权重必须为负。单独一条权重为 -2 的 A→B 边不能证明任一条件。

q.en: If two crossing edges tie for minimum weight, is every MST forced to contain both?
q.zh: 两条跨割边并列最小，是否每棵 MST 都必须含两条？

a.en: No. A light edge is safe for some compatible MST, but ties can produce different optimal trees. Uniqueness needs stronger conditions.
a.zh: 不。轻边对某棵兼容 MST 安全，但并列可产生不同最优树；唯一性需更强条件。

q.en: Why reject AC after accepting AB and BC?
q.zh: 接受 AB、BC 后为何拒绝 AC？

a.en: A and C are already connected through B. Adding AC would create a cycle.
a.zh: A、C 已经通过 B 连通，加 AC 会成环。

q.en: What does path compression change?
q.zh: 路径压缩改变什么？

a.en: It shortens links in the union-find bookkeeping forest. It does not change the graph's selected cables.
a.zh: 缩短并查集管理森林中的链接，不改变图中所选电缆。

q.en: Can an MST contain a negative-weight edge?
q.zh: MST 可以包含负权边吗？

a.en: Yes. The MST proof allows negative weights. Dijkstra's nonnegative requirement belongs to a different problem.
a.zh: 可以，MST 证明允许负权；Dijkstra 的非负要求属于不同问题。

q.en: Can density-greedy fail for 0/1 knapsack with capacity 10 and items (weight,value)=(6,12),(5,9),(5,9)?

a.en: Yes. It picks the density-2 item for value 12, while the two weight-5 items fit together and give value 18.
a.zh: 会。选密度 2 的首项得 12，两件重 5 项一起恰好放下，却得 18。

q.en: Why compare densities instead of full values?
q.zh: 为何比密度而非整件价值？

a.en: The capacity limits weight. Density measures what each unit of that scarce weight buys in usefulness.
a.zh: 容量限制重量，密度衡量每单位稀缺重量能换多少实用价值。

q.en: Why is the last fraction of C equal to one sixth?
q.zh: 最后 C 的比例为何为六分之一？

a.en: A and B use 9 of 10 kilograms. C weighs 6 kilograms, so taking one kilogram means taking 1/6 of C.
a.zh: A、B 用去 10 千克中的 9 千克，C 整件重 6，所以一千克就是 1/6。

q.en: Why does the proof fail for sealed boxes?
q.zh: 为什么证明对密封箱失效？

a.en: A box cannot be exchanged kilogram by kilogram. Feasible fractional choices may be impossible when each box is indivisible.
a.zh: 箱子不能逐千克交换，可行的分数选择在整件不可分时可能无法实现。

q.en: Why not use F(i,c-w_i) when taking an item?
q.zh: 拿取物品时，为什么不能用 F(i,c-w_i)？

a.en: That state may already contain item i. Adding v_i could reuse it. Row i-1 contains only earlier items.
a.zh: 该状态可能已经包含第 i 件物品，再加 v_i 就可能重复拿取。第 i-1 行只包含之前的物品。

q.en: Why is the smallest current finish time enough to test whether any room is available?
q.zh: 为何最小当前结束时间就够判断是否有房？

a.en: If even the earliest-finishing room ends after the new start, all rooms are busy. Otherwise that earliest room is safe to reuse.
a.zh: 若最早结束房仍晚于新开始，则全忙；否则这个最早房可安全复用。

q.en: Why can C start in room 1 at time 4?
q.zh: C 为何可在时间 4 用房 1？

a.en: A ends at 4, and [1,4) excludes that finish time. Room 1 is free when C begins.
a.zh: A 在 4 结束，[1,4) 不含结束，所以 C 开始时已空闲。

q.en: Why can one room never serve these four sessions?
q.zh: 为什么一房不可能？

a.en: A and B overlap between times 2 and 4, so they need separate rooms.
a.zh: A、B 在 2 到 4 重叠，必须分房。

q.en: What changes if cleaning needs one extra time unit?
q.zh: 若清理需额外一单位时间呢？

a.en: A room is unavailable until finish+1. Adjust the occupied intervals before applying the same scheduling logic.
a.zh: 房间到 finish+1 才可用，先调整占用区间再用调度规则。

q.en: Why can Huffman merge subtrees rather than only original symbols?
q.zh: 为何能合并子树而不只原始符号？

a.en: A merged subtree acts as one aggregate symbol whose weight is the total frequency inside it. Moving that subtree one level deeper adds exactly its aggregate weight to cost.
a.zh: 子树可当一个聚合符号，权为内部总频率。整体深一层恰好增加该权重的成本。

q.en: Why do rare symbols usually receive longer codes?
q.zh: 稀有符号为何通常码更长？

a.en: A long code is paid each time its symbol appears. Giving extra bits to rare symbols usually adds less total cost.
a.zh: 每次出现都要支付码长，给稀有符号加位通常增加总成本更少。

q.en: Why does joining weights 2 and 4 add six bits?
q.zh: 合并 2、4 为何加六位？

a.en: There are six total occurrences below the new parent. Each path gains one edge, adding one bit per occurrence.
a.zh: 新父下总共六次出现，每条路径增一边，每次增一位。

q.en: Must two correct Huffman programs print identical codewords?
q.zh: 两个正确程序必须输出同一码字吗？

a.en: No. Tie choices and left/right labels can differ. Compare prefix validity and total weighted length, not only the literal bit strings.
a.zh: 不。并列选择和左右标签可不同，应比较前缀有效性和加权总长，不只字面位串。

q.en: What is the cost of binary search on a linked list if each midpoint requires a scan of the current segment?
q.zh: 链表二分若每次扫描当前段找中点，成本多少？

a.en: Θ(n) under that implementation: n+n/2+n/4+⋯ is Θ(n), so logarithmic depth does not yield logarithmic total work.
a.zh: 该实现为 Θ(n)：n+n/2+n/4+… 为 Θ(n)，对数深度不等于对数总工作。

q.en: Why does merge compare only the two front values?
q.zh: 合并为何只比两前端？

a.en: Every later value in either sorted half is no smaller than its front. The smallest remaining value must be one of those two fronts.
a.zh: 任一半后面的值都不小于其前端，所以剩余最小值必在两前端之一。

q.en: Why is merge sort not O(log n) just because it has logarithmic depth?
q.zh: 为何归并不是深度所暗示的 O(log n)？

a.en: It visits many subproblems at each depth. Together their merges process O(n) values per level.
a.zh: 每层访问许多子问题，合并起来处理 O(n) 项。

q.en: Why does binary search keep indices rather than make slices?
q.zh: 二分为何保留索引而不切片？

a.en: Copying a slice costs time proportional to its length. Moving index boundaries avoids that hidden linear work.
a.zh: 复制切片的成本与长度成比例，移动索引边界可避免隐含线性工作。

q.en: Does the comparison lower bound rule out linear-time sorting of a list of bits?
q.zh: 比较下界禁止线性排序二进制位列表吗？

a.en: No. Bits have a tiny known key universe; counting zeros and ones uses information beyond arbitrary-key pairwise comparisons.
a.zh: 不。位的已知取值范围很小，计数零一利用了任意键两两比较之外的信息。

q.en: Why are equal values placed in a finished middle group?
q.zh: 相等值为何进入已完成中间组？

a.en: They already have the same rank block relative to the pivot. Recursing on them cannot improve their order.
a.zh: 相对枢轴已处相同秩区块，继续递归不能改善其顺序。

q.en: What happens if the first pivot is always the smallest?
q.zh: 若首枢轴始终最小呢？

a.en: Only that pivot is removed. The remaining sizes are n−1, n−2 and so on, causing quadratic total partition work.
a.zh: 每次只移除枢轴，剩余 n−1、n−2 等，分区总工作二次。

q.en: Does the comparison lower bound forbid counting sort?
q.zh: 比较下界禁止计数排序吗？

a.en: No. Counting sort uses a bounded key range, not just pairwise comparisons of arbitrary keys. Its costs must include that range.
a.zh: 不。计数排序利用有界键范围，成本也必须包括该范围。

q.en: If p=(5,7) and q=(5,6), does p dominate q under this definition?

a.en: Yes. p is equal in x and strictly better in y. Distinct-coordinate simplifications must not silently change the intended domination relation.
a.zh: 是，x 相等而 y 严格更好。不同坐标的简化不能偷偷改变支配定义。

q.en: Why is B=(3,5) removed?
q.zh: B=(3,5) 为何删除？

a.en: C=(4,7) is larger in both coordinates, so C is a concrete witness that B is dominated.
a.zh: C=(4,7) 两坐标都更大，是具体支配见证。

q.en: Why is A=(1,8) kept even though its x is small?
q.zh: A 的 x 小为何保留？

a.en: No point with larger x reaches y=8. A offers a tradeoff that the other points do not replace.
a.zh: 更大 x 的点都到不了 y=8，A 提供其他点无法替代的取舍。

q.en: What if two records have exactly the same coordinates?
q.zh: 记录坐标完全相同怎么办？

a.en: Neither strictly dominates the other. This demonstration keeps one representative objective pair; an application may preserve both records.
a.zh: 它们互不严格支配。演示保留一个目标对代表，应用也可保留两个记录。

q.en: Why does reducing four half-size multiplications to three change the exponent?
q.zh: 四个半规模乘法减到三个，为何改变指数？

a.en: At depth log₂n, recursive branching creates about 4^log₂n=n² leaves versus 3^log₂n=n^log₂3. The saving repeats at every level.
a.zh: 深度 log₂n 时，叶子数从 4^log₂n=n² 变成 3^log₂n=n^log₂3，节省在每层重复。

q.en: How does 55 recover the cross term in 23×47?
q.zh: 55 如何恢复交叉项？

a.en: (2+3)(4+7)=55 contains all four small products. Subtract 2×4=8 and 3×7=21, leaving 26.

q.en: Why does 26 get multiplied by 10 during recombination?
q.zh: 重组时 26 为何乘 10？

a.en: Each cross term contains exactly one tens factor. The high product has two tens factors, so it receives 100.
a.zh: 每个交叉项恰有一个十位因子，高乘积有两个，因此乘 100。

q.en: Can we use the Master theorem on any recursive function?
q.zh: 任何递归都能套主定理吗？

a.en: No. Its displayed form needs a fixed number of equally scaled subproblems and suitable local-work conditions. Unequal branches need another argument.
a.zh: 不能，给出形式要求固定数量、同比例子问题及合适局部成本；不等分支需其他论证。

q.en: Why does an exact-median pivot not automatically give a complete linear-time selection algorithm?
q.zh: 为什么精确中位数枢轴不能自动给完整线性算法？

a.en: Finding that exact median is itself a selection problem. Its cost must be included; assuming it is free makes the argument circular.
a.zh: 找精确中位数本身就是选择问题，必须计成本，假设免费会循环论证。

q.en: Why is 7 the fourth-smallest value in the example?
q.zh: 7 为何第四小？

a.en: Three values, 3, 5 and 1, are smaller. The next rank is therefore occupied by 7.
a.zh: 3、5、1 三项较小，下一秩就是 7。

q.en: Why does rank 6 become rank 2 in the larger group?
q.zh: 秩 6 为何变为大组秩 2？

a.en: The smaller group has 3 values and the equal group has 1. Subtracting those four earlier ranks gives 6−4=2.
a.zh: 小组三项、相等组一项，减去前四秩，6−4=2。

q.en: Is the value at the middle array index the median?
q.zh: 数组中间索引的值就是中位数吗？

a.en: Not generally. The array may be unsorted. Middle position is a deterministic pivot rule, not a guarantee about the pivot's value.
a.zh: 通常不是，数组可能未排序。中间位置是确定枢轴规则，不保证其值居中。

q.en: Why is a self-swap allowed?
q.zh: 为什么允许自交换？

a.en: The card already at the current position must have the same chance to remain there as any other remaining card has to move there.
a.zh: 当前位置的卡与其他剩余卡一样，应有相同机会占据这个最终位置。

q.en: Why are there six choice sequences for three cards?
q.zh: 三张卡为何六条路径？

a.en: The last position has 3 options and the next has 2. Multiplying gives 3×2=6.
a.zh: 末位三选、下一位二选，3×2=6。

q.en: Why is choosing j=i necessary?
q.zh: 为何必须允许 j=i？

a.en: The card already in the current position must be allowed to stay. Otherwise it has zero chance of occupying that final position at that step.
a.zh: 原来在当前位置的卡必须能留下，否则该步占此最终位置概率为零。

q.en: Does printing one mixed-up order prove uniformity?
q.zh: 打印一个混乱顺序证明均匀吗？

a.en: No. Uniformity concerns the probabilities of all outcomes. The example checks every choice sequence only because three cards make that enumeration small.
a.zh: 不能，均匀涉及全部结果的概率。三张牌足够小，示例才能检查每条选择序列。

q.en: If every promotion coin happened to fail immediately, would search still be correct?
q.zh: 若每次晋升硬币一开始就失败，搜索仍正确吗？

a.en: Yes. The structure becomes a sorted linked list: correctness survives, but search can take linear time in that unlucky realization.
a.zh: 正确，退化为有序链表，但该倒霉布局中搜索可线性。

q.en: Why does searching for 17 stop moving right after 11 at the upper level?
q.zh: 查 17 为何上层在 11 后不再右移？

a.en: The next available upper-level key is 24 or the list ends. Moving there would pass 17, so search descends.
a.zh: 下一上层键为 24 或到末端，移动会越过 17，因此下降。

q.en: What is reconnected when 20 gets a two-level tower?
q.zh: 20 两层塔插入时重接什么？

a.en: At the base, 17 points to 20 and 20 points to 24. On level 1, 11 points to 20 and 20 points to 24.

q.en: What if every promotion coin fails?
q.zh: 所有晋升失败会怎样？

a.en: All keys stay only at the base. Search is still correct, but it can take O(n) time like an ordinary sorted linked list.
a.zh: 所有键只在底层，仍正确，但像普通有序链表一样可需 O(n)。

q.en: Why can O(√q) be expensive even though the square-root function grows slowly?
q.zh: 平方根增长慢，O(√q) 为什么仍昂贵？

a.en: The input encodes q in about k=log₂q bits. Then √q is about 2^(k/2), exponential in input bit length.
a.zh: 输入只需约 k=log₂q 位，√q≈2^(k/2)，对输入位长是指数。

q.en: Why do both students calculate 18?
q.zh: 两位学生为何都得到 18？

a.en: One computes (5⁴)³ and the other (5³)⁴ modulo 23. Both equal 5¹² modulo 23.
a.zh: 分别算 (5⁴)³ 与 (5³)⁴ 模 23，都等于 5¹² 模 23。

q.en: Why is trial search easy in the example?
q.zh: 示例为何容易试出秘密？

a.en: The nonzero group modulo 23 has only 22 possible exponents modulo its order. An observer can try them directly.
a.zh: 模 23 非零群按阶只有 22 种指数，可直接逐个试。

q.en: Why is O(√q) not polynomial in the input bit length?
q.zh: O(√q) 为何不是位长多项式？

a.en: If q is about 2ᵏ, then √q is about 2^(k/2). Doubling k greatly increases that search space even though writing the input uses only k bits.
a.zh: q≈2ᵏ 时 √q≈2^(k/2)，写输入只用 k 位，但 k 加倍会显著扩大搜索空间。

title.en: A running total and its invariant

intro.en: A prefix is the part of a list from its beginning to some position. Print the total after every new value.
intro.zh: 前缀是列表开头到某位置的部分。每来一个新值就打印总数。

questions.code:
values = [4, -1, 6, 2]
total = 0
prefixes = []
for value in values:
    total += value
    prefixes.append(total)
    print(value, total)
print(prefixes)

en: Initialize total to the empty-prefix sum 0 and prefixes to an empty list.
Add the next value before recording total, preserving the processed-prefix invariant.
Print each transition and the complete prefix list after the loop.
zh: 将 total 初始化为空前缀和 0，prefixes 为空列表。
先加下个值再记录 total，保持已处理前缀不变量。
打印每次变化，循环后打印完整前缀表。

title.en: Count the cost of growing storage

intro.en: Separate ordinary writes from copies caused by doubling capacity.
intro.zh: 把普通写入与容量翻倍引起的复制分开计数。

questions.code:
capacity = 1
size = 0
copies = 0
for value in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]:
    if size == capacity:
        copies += size
        capacity *= 2
    size += 1
    print("size:", size, "capacity:", capacity, "copies:", copies)
print("writes plus copies:", size + copies)
questions.output:
size: 1 capacity: 1 copies: 0
size: 2 capacity: 2 copies: 1
size: 3 capacity: 4 copies: 3
size: 4 capacity: 4 copies: 3
size: 5 capacity: 8 copies: 7
writes plus copies: 12

en: Start with one available cell and no stored values.
Before each write, double only if every current cell is occupied.
Charge each old cell once for a resize, then charge one new write.
zh: 从一个可用单元和零个值开始。
每次写入前，仅在当前单元全满时翻倍。
每次扩容对每个旧单元计一次复制，再计一次新写入。

title.en: See an array insertion shift values
title.zh: 观察数组插入怎样移动值

intro.en: Build an insertion by hand instead of hiding it inside list.insert.
intro.zh: 手工建立插入过程，不藏在 list.insert 中。

questions.code:
items = ["L", "M", "N", "P"]
position = 1
items.append(None)
shifts = 0
for i in range(len(items) - 1, position, -1):
    items[i] = items[i - 1]
    shifts += 1
items[position] = "X"
print(items)
print("shifts:", shifts)

en: Append a spare cell so the last item has a destination.
Copy entries from right to left, preserving values not copied yet.
Fill the gap at position 1 with X and report three shifts.
zh: 追加备用单元，让末项有位置可去。
从右往左复制，保留尚未复制的值。
在位置 1 写 X，报告三次移动。

title.en: Insert a real node into a linked chain
title.zh: 向真实链式节点中插入

intro.en: Here the program already knows node M. Watch it insert X after M without moving N.
intro.zh: 程序已知节点 M，观察在 M 后插 X 而不移动 N。

questions.code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next_node=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next_node

n = Node("N")
m = Node("M", n)
head = Node("L", m)
old_next = m.next
m.next = Node("X", old_next)
values = []
current = head
while current is not None:
    values.append(current.value)
    current = current.next
print(values)
print("X still links to N:", m.next.next is n)
questions.output:
['L', 'M', 'X', 'N']
X still links to N: True

en: Construct the chain backward so every next reference already exists.
Save M’s successor, create X pointing to it, then redirect M to X.
Follow next references and check that the old N object remains linked.
zh: 反向构建链，让每个 next 引用已存在。
保存 M 后继，创建指向后继的 X，再让 M 指 X。
沿 next 遍历，确认旧 N 对象仍连通。

title.en: Match brackets with a stack

intro.en: The function checks both matching types and matching order.
intro.zh: 函数同时检查括号类型和顺序。

en: Map each closer to its opener and begin with no unmatched brackets.
Push openers; a closer must safely pop a matching top.
Reject early mismatches and reject leftover openers after the scan.
zh: 建立右到左的映射，初始无未匹配括号。
左括号入栈；右括号必须安全弹出匹配栈顶。
提前拒绝不匹配，扫描后拒绝剩余左括号。

title.en: Serve waiting jobs with deque
title.zh: 用 deque 服务等待任务

intro.en: A deque is a double-ended queue. Use its right end for arrival and left end for service.
intro.zh: deque 是双端队列，右端到达，左端服务。

questions.code:
from collections import deque
queue = deque(["Ada", "Bo"])
queue.append("Cy")
print("served:", queue.popleft())
print("waiting:", list(queue))
queue.appendleft("urgent")
print("left end:", queue.popleft())
print("waiting:", list(queue))
questions.output:
served: Ada
waiting: ['Bo', 'Cy']
left end: urgent
waiting: ['Bo', 'Cy']

en: Append Cy behind Ada and Bo, preserving arrival order.
Remove Ada from the left and display the two remaining jobs.
Insert urgent at the left to demonstrate an explicit change of policy.
zh: 把 Cy 追加在 Ada、Bo 后，保持到达顺序。
从左移除 Ada，显示两个剩余任务。
在左插 urgent，展示明确的策略改变。

title.en: Compare three traversal orders

intro.en: Represent a node as a tuple containing its label, left branch and right branch. None is an empty branch.
intro.zh: 节点用标签、左分支、右分支组成元组，None 表示空分支。

en: Return an empty sequence for None, the stopping case.
Recursively obtain left and right orders, then place the current label before, between or after them.
Run the same tree through all three placement rules.
zh: None 返回空序列，作为停止情形。
递归取得左右顺序，再将当前标签放前、中或后。
让同一棵树经过三种放置规则。

title.en: Calculate size and height together

intro.en: Return both facts from each branch so no branch needs a second scan.
intro.zh: 每分支一次返回两项事实，避免再扫描。

questions.code:
tree = ("R", ("A", ("C", None, None), None), ("B", None, None))
def facts(node):
    if node is None:
        return 0, -1
    _, left, right = node
    left_size, left_height = facts(left)
    right_size, right_height = facts(right)
    return 1 + left_size + right_size, 1 + max(left_height, right_height)

size, height = facts(tree)
print("size:", size)
print("height:", height)
print("empty:", facts(None))

en: Use (0,-1) for an empty branch to make the formulas work at leaves.
Request size and height together from each child.
Add one for the parent and choose the longer child height.
zh: 空分支用 (0,-1)，让叶子也能套公式。
向每个孩子同时请求大小和高度。
父亲大小加一，高度取较长孩子加一。

title.en: Insert keys and record the search route
title.zh: 插入键并记录搜索路线

intro.en: These are actual linked tree nodes, not a call to Python sorting.
intro.zh: 这里使用真实链接树节点，不调用 Python 排序。

en: Insert each key by reconnecting the root returned by the recursive call.
At each comparison, rule out the subtree on the wrong side.
Stop at 22 or at None, recording the route for inspection.
zh: 插入时重接递归返回的根。
每次比较排除错误方向子树。
到 22 或 None 停止，并记录路线供检查。

title.en: Report a range without visiting every branch
title.zh: 报告区间并剪掉无用分支

intro.en: Use a nested tuple to keep this range-query example short. Each tuple is key, left, right.
intro.zh: 用嵌套元组保持示例简短，每元组依次为键、左、右。

en: Check whether the left subtree could intersect the lower bound.
Append the current key only when both inclusive bounds accept it.
Check the right subtree separately to retain inorder output.
zh: 检查左子树是否可能与下界相交。
仅当当前键满足包含两端的界时追加。
独立检查右子树，以保持中序输出。

title.en: Rotate an outer-heavy branch right
title.zh: 向右旋转外侧偏重分支

intro.en: All nodes store heights. The helper recalculates a node after its links change.
intro.zh: 所有节点保存高度，辅助函数在链接改变后重算高度。

questions.code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, key):
        self.key, self.left, self.right, self.height = key, None, None, 0
def height(node):
    return -1 if node is None else node.height
def update(node):
    node.height = 1 + max(height(node.left), height(node.right))
def rotate_right(root):
    new_root = root.left
    root.left = new_root.right
    new_root.right = root
    update(root)
    update(new_root)
    return new_root
root = Node(30)
root.left = Node(20)
root.left.left = Node(10)
update(root.left)
update(root)
print("before height:", root.height)
root = rotate_right(root)
print("keys:", root.left.key, root.key, root.right.key)
print("after height:", root.height)

en: Build 30→20→10 and update heights from the leaf upward.
Promote the left child while transferring its middle subtree to the old root.
Update the old root before the promoted root, then inspect height and order.
zh: 建立 30→20→10，从叶向上更新高度。
提升左孩子，同时把中间子树转给旧根。
先更新旧根，再更新新根，检查高度与顺序。

title.en: Repair an inner-heavy branch

intro.en: First straighten 30–10–20 with a left rotation. Then perform a right rotation.
intro.zh: 先左旋理顺 30–10–20，再右旋。

questions.code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, key, left=None, right=None):
        self.key, self.left, self.right = key, left, right
def rotate_left(root):
    top = root.right
    root.right = top.left
    top.left = root
    return top
def rotate_right(root):
    top = root.left
    root.left = top.right
    top.right = root
    return top
root = Node(30, Node(10, right=Node(20)))
root.left = rotate_left(root.left)
print("after first:", root.key, root.left.key, root.left.left.key)
root = rotate_right(root)
print("after second:", root.left.key, root.key, root.right.key)

en: Recognize the left-right bend before choosing a repair.
Rotate at child 10 and reconnect the returned root 20 to node 30.
Rotate at 30 to make 20 the root and inspect both children.
zh: 先识别左—右弯，再选择修复。
在孩子 10 左旋，把返回的 20 重新接到 30。
在 30 右旋，让 20 成根，检查两孩子。

title.en: Use heapq to serve priorities
title.zh: 用 heapq 按优先级服务

intro.en: heapify builds the heap. heappop removes its smallest entry.
intro.zh: heapify 建堆，heappop 移除最小项。

questions.code:
import heapq
jobs = [8, 3, 5, 12, 10]
heapq.heapify(jobs)
print("minimum:", jobs[0])
heapq.heappush(jobs, 4)
served = []
while jobs:
    served.append(heapq.heappop(jobs))
print("served:", served)

en: Heapify the five jobs and read the root as the minimum.
Push priority 4 and let heapq restore parent-child order.
Repeatedly remove minima, extending a sorted service history.
zh: 将五任务建堆，读取根为最小值。
压入优先级 4，由 heapq 恢复父子顺序。
反复移除最小值，扩展有序服务历史。

title.en: Write the heap insertion repair

intro.en: Watch the new value 4 move from index 5 to index 2.
intro.zh: 观察新值 4 从索引 5 移到 2。

questions.code:
heap = [3, 8, 5, 12, 10]
heap.append(4)
i = len(heap) - 1
swaps = 0
while i > 0:
    parent = (i - 1) // 2
    if heap[parent] <= heap[i]:
        break
    heap[parent], heap[i] = heap[i], heap[parent]
    i = parent
    swaps += 1
print(heap)
print("swaps:", swaps)
print("valid:", all(heap[(j - 1) // 2] <= heap[j] for j in range(1, len(heap))))

en: Append 4 and initialize i to its new index 5.
Compare with parent index 2 and swap the violating pair.
Stop beneath 3, then independently audit all parent inequalities.
zh: 追加 4，令 i 为新索引 5。
与父索引 2 比较并交换违法的一对。
在 3 下停止，再独立检查全部父不等式。

title.en: Watch insertion sort grow a prefix
title.zh: 观察插入排序扩展前缀

intro.en: Print the full array after each insertion and count the values shifted.
intro.zh: 每次插入后打印数组，并计移动数量。

questions.code:
values = [5, 2, 4, 1]
shifts = 0
for i in range(1, len(values)):
    item = values[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and values[j] > item:
        values[j + 1] = values[j]
        j -= 1
        shifts += 1
    values[j + 1] = item
    print(values)
print("shifts:", shifts)

en: Save the next unsorted item before shifting any cells.
Move every larger prefix value right until the insertion gap appears.
Write the saved item into the gap and print the enlarged sorted prefix.
zh: 移动前保存下个未排项。
把前缀更大值右移，直到找到插入空位。
写入保存项，打印扩大的有序前缀。

title.en: Sort by repeatedly removing a heap minimum
title.zh: 反复移除堆最小值完成排序

intro.en: This is a clear heap-based sorting version with a separate result list.
intro.zh: 这是使用独立结果表的清晰堆排序版本。

questions.code:
import heapq
values = [5, 2, 4, 1]
heap = values.copy()
heapq.heapify(heap)
result = []
while heap:
    result.append(heapq.heappop(heap))
print("input:", values)
print("sorted:", result)

en: Copy the input so the original remains available for comparison.
Build a min-heap in the copy.
Append each removed minimum to result until the heap is empty.
zh: 复制输入，保留原表供比较。
把每次移除的最小值追加到 result，直到堆空。

title.en: Store colliding keys in one bucket

intro.en: This tiny map uses integer remainders so the printed bucket placement is deterministic.
intro.zh: 用整数余数构建小映射，使桶位置输出确定。

en: Create seven independent bucket lists rather than seven references to one list.
Send each integer key to key%7 and preserve its paired value.
Scan bucket 3 using actual key equality for both present 24 and absent 31.
zh: 建立七个独立桶表，而不是同表的七个引用。
把整数键送到 key%7，并保留配对值。
对存在的 24 和缺失的 31 都扫描桶 3，并检查真实键相等。

title.en: Delete without breaking a probe chain

intro.en: A unique object marks a deleted slot. It is never printed, so output does not depend on memory addresses.
intro.zh: 用唯一对象标记删除槽，不打印对象，因此输出不依赖地址。

questions.code:
deleted = object()
table = [None] * 7
for key in [10, 17, 24]:
    index = key % 7
    while table[index] is not None:
        index = (index + 1) % 7
    table[index] = key
table[4] = deleted
def contains(key):
    visited = []
    for offset in range(len(table)):
        index = (key % 7 + offset) % 7
        visited.append(index)
        item = table[index]
        if item is None:
            return False, visited
        if item is not deleted and item == key:
            return True, visited
    return False, visited
print(contains(24))
table[4] = None
print(contains(24))

en: Insert the three colliding keys in adjacent slots.
Delete 17 with a marker and verify that search for 24 passes it.
Replace the marker with None to demonstrate a broken stopping rule.
zh: 把三碰撞键放入相邻槽。
用标记删 17，验证查 24 能越过它。
把标记换 None，展示错误的停止规则。

title.en: Follow a bounded cuckoo insertion
title.zh: 追踪有界的布谷鸟插入

intro.en: The two hash rules are fixed for this small demonstration. They illustrate relocation, not good general-purpose hashing.
intro.zh: 固定两哈希规则用于小演示，说明迁移而非通用好哈希。

questions.code:
first = [None] * 3
second = [None] * 3
def insert(key):
    board = 0
    for _ in range(8):
        table = first if board == 0 else second
        index = key % 3 if board == 0 else (key // 3) % 3
        table[index], key = key, table[index]
        if key is None:
            return
        board = 1 - board
    raise RuntimeError("Rebuild required; an evicted key remains")
for key in [0, 3, 6]:
    insert(key)
print("first:", first)
print("second:", second)
print("3 found:", first[3 % 3] == 3 or second[(3 // 3) % 3] == 3)
questions.output:
first: [6, None, None]
second: [0, 3, None]
3 found: True

en: Try each incoming key in its first-table home.
Keep an evicted key in the local variable and move it to its other table.
Finish only on an empty cell; otherwise signal rebuilding after the move limit.
zh: 先尝试新键在第一表的位置。
在局部变量保留被逐键，移到另一表。
只在空槽结束；达到移动上限则报告需重建。

title.en: Separate membership from multiplicity

intro.en: Use standard-library containers to show what different collection contracts mean.
intro.zh: 用标准库容器展示不同集合契约。

questions.code:
from collections import Counter
colors = ["red", "blue", "red"]
members = set(colors)
counts = Counter(colors)
print("red present:", "red" in members)
print("distinct:", len(members))
print("red count:", counts["red"])
print("total:", sum(counts.values()))
questions.output:
red present: True
distinct: 2
red count: 2
total: 3

en: Use the same three color occurrences for both containers.
Ask set for membership and Counter for the number of red occurrences.
Compare distinct count with the sum of all occurrence counts.
zh: 两个容器都使用相同三次颜色出现。
向 set 查成员，向 Counter 查 red 次数。
比较不同成员数与出现总次数。

title.en: Build an undirected adjacency list

intro.en: Use an ordinary dictionary to map each room to a list of neighboring rooms.
intro.zh: 用普通字典把每个房间映射到邻居列表。

questions.output:
A ['B', 'C']
B ['A', 'D']
C ['A', 'D']
D ['B', 'C']
E []
degree sum: 8
twice edges: 8

en: Create a dictionary entry for every vertex, including isolated E.
Record each undirected edge at both endpoints.
Count all neighbor entries and compare the result with twice the edge count.
zh: 为每顶点建字典项，包括孤立 E。
在两端都记录每条无向边。
统计全部邻居项，与边数两倍比较。

title.en: Trade matrix space for direct edge tests
title.zh: 用矩阵空间换取直接查边

intro.en: Store a directed graph. Direction makes the two matrix entries different.
intro.zh: 存储有向图。方向使对称的两个矩阵单元可以不同。

questions.code:
vertices = ["A", "B", "C"]
index = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(vertices)}
matrix = [[False] * 3 for _ in vertices]
for u, v in [("A", "B"), ("B", "C")]:
    matrix[index[u]][index[v]] = True
print("A to B:", matrix[index["A"]][index["B"]])
print("B to A:", matrix[index["B"]][index["A"]])
neighbors = [vertices[j] for j in range(3) if matrix[index["B"]][j]]
print("B neighbors:", neighbors)
print("cells:", sum(len(row) for row in matrix))
questions.output:
A to B: True
B to A: False
B neighbors: ['C']
cells: 9

en: Build the label-to-index dictionary and three independent rows.
Set A→B and B→C, without setting reverse entries.
Read a single cell for membership, then scan a full row for neighbors.
zh: 建立标签到索引的字典和三个独立行。
设置 A→B 与 B→C，不设置反向单元。
查边时读取一个单元，找邻居时扫描整行。

title.en: Find a bridge with discovery and low values
title.zh: 用发现时间与 low 找桥

intro.en: This is a small simple undirected graph: no parallel edges or self-loops.
intro.zh: 这是没有平行边或自环的简单无向小图。

en: Assign a discovery number and initialize low when a vertex is first entered.
Finish each unseen child, then propagate its low value and test the bridge inequality.
Use nonparent visited edges to lower low and restart DFS for unvisited components.
zh: 首次进入时分配发现编号并初始化 low。
完成每个未见孩子，再传播 low 并检查桥条件。
用非父已访问边降低 low，并在未见分量重启 DFS。

title.en: Explore without recursive calls
title.zh: 不用递归调用完成探索

intro.en: A stack stores unfinished visits. This example finds reachability, not bridge low values.
intro.zh: 栈保存尚待访问的顶点。此例求可达性，不计算桥所需的 low 值。

en: Place only A on the stack; the seen set is initially empty.
Remove a vertex, skip an already processed one, and record its first visit.
Push neighbors in reverse order so the next pop follows the desired branch.
zh: 栈最初只有 A，seen 集合为空。
取出顶点，跳过已处理项，记录首次访问。
逆序压入邻居，让下一次出栈沿预期分支深入。
随后栈状态，右端为栈顶

title.en: Use a queue to find distance and a route

intro.en: An isolated vertex X shows how the result represents an unreachable destination.
intro.zh: 孤立顶点 X 展示不可达目的地的表示。

questions.output:
distance to E: 3
route: ['S', 'A', 'C', 'E']
distance to X: None

en: Initialize S to distance zero and all other distances to None.
Enqueue each unseen neighbor only after assigning its distance and parent.
Follow E’s parent chain backward, reverse it, and retain X’s missing marker.
zh: S 初始化零，其他距离 None。
先给未见邻居距离和父亲，再入队。
逆向走 E 父链再反转，保留 X 缺失标记。

title.en: Find distance to the nearest starting point

intro.en: Start from both ends of a path. All starting vertices have distance zero.
intro.zh: 从路径两端同时开始。所有起点的距离都是零。

en: Assign 0 to sources 0 and 4, then enqueue both.
First visits from the two ends discover vertices 1 and 3 at distance 1.
Discover the middle once at distance 2 and ignore its later duplicate route.
zh: 给起点 0、4 赋距离零，并全部入队。
两端的首次扩展发现顶点 1、3，距离为 1。
以距离 2 发现中点一次，忽略后来到达的重复路线。

title.en: Start BFS from every exit at once
title.zh: 让 BFS 同时从所有出口出发

intro.en: A school map has two exits. Mina wants the number of corridor steps from every cell to its nearest exit. Running a separate search from every cell repeats much of the same work. She puts both exits into one queue at distance zero. Their waves spread together. The first wave reaching a cell already gives its nearest-exit distance.
intro.zh: 学校地图有两个出口。米娜想知道每个位置到最近出口需要走几步。如果从每个格子分别搜索，会重复大量工作。她把两个出口都以距离零加入同一个队列，让两股波同时扩散。某个格子第一次被波到达时，就得到了到最近出口的距离。

en: Seed all exits before processing any cell. Each exit starts in the same distance layer, zero.
Mark a cell when enqueuing it. This stops two waves from adding the same cell repeatedly.
Each legal move adds one. FIFO order finishes one distance layer before the next.
Print # for walls and X for unreachable open cells. Missing data should not silently become distance zero.
zh: 处理格子之前先放入全部出口，每个出口都在距离零这一层。
入队时立即标记，避免两股波反复加入同一格子。
每次合法移动增加一步，FIFO 顺序保证先处理完较近层。
墙显示 #，不可达空格显示 X；缺失结果不能默认为距离零。

title.en: Trace shorter routes with a lazy heap
title.zh: 用惰性堆追踪更短路线

intro.en: This self-contained example uses a directed graph with nonnegative integer weights.
intro.zh: 独立示例使用非负整数权有向图。

en: Push the source’s zero-distance proposal and initialize all other labels to infinity.
Skip stale proposals; otherwise relax each outgoing edge using the complete route cost.
Update parent with each improvement and reconstruct the reachable destination’s route.
zh: 压入源点零距离候选，其他标签无穷。
跳过旧候选，否则用完整路线成本松弛出边。
每次改善同时更新父亲，并重建可达目的地路线。

title.en: Choose a minimum without a heap

intro.en: An array-style scan makes settlement visible and keeps an unreachable vertex explicit.
intro.zh: 逐项扫描使定点过程清楚可见，并明确保留不可达顶点。

questions.output:
settled: S 0
settled: A 0
settled: B 2
X: inf

en: Initialize only S to zero; all other labels are infinity.
Scan unsettled labels and finalize the smallest finite one.
Relax its outgoing edges and stop when only unreachable vertices remain.
zh: 仅把 S 初始化为零，其他距离均为无穷大。
扫描未定点距离，把最小有限值定点。
松弛出边；仅剩不可达顶点时停止。

title.en: Handle a negative edge with Bellman–Ford
title.zh: 用 Bellman–Ford 处理负权边

intro.en: Mina models route scores, where a training station can give a bonus represented by a negative edge. She cannot assume that a node with a small current score is settled forever. She instead asks a safer question: what is the best score using at most one edge, then two, then three? If a reachable loop keeps reducing the score, she reports that there is no finite minimum rather than printing a misleading route.
intro.zh: 米娜为路线打分，某个训练站的奖励可以表示为负权边。她不能再认为当前分数较小的节点已经永久确定。于是改问一个更稳妥的问题：最多用一条边、两条边、三条边时，最佳分数分别是多少？若可达环让分数一直下降，她就报告不存在有限最优值，而不是输出误导性的路线。

questions.output:
at most 0 edges: [0, inf, inf, inf]
at most 1 edges: [0, 4, 5, inf]
at most 2 edges: [0, 4, 2, 8]
at most 3 edges: [0, 4, 2, 5]
Z is unreachable: True
reachable negative cycle

en: Start with source distance zero and every other distance infinite. Zero edges can reach only the source.
Read the previous dictionary and write a new one. Each pass adds at most one edge, matching the stated invariant exactly.
Run at most |V|-1 passes. Without a reachable negative cycle, a best path can be chosen without repeated vertices.
Try one more relaxation. Improvement then exposes a reachable negative cycle. Ignore unreachable origins such as Z.
zh: 源点距离设为零，其他设为无穷。零条边只能到达源点。
读取旧字典、写入新字典，每轮最多多用一条边，严格对应不变量。
最多运行 |V|-1 轮。没有可达负环时，可以选择不重复顶点的最短路径。
再尝试一轮松弛，若还能改善就存在可达负环；忽略 Z 这类不可达起点。

title.en: Build an MST with union-find

intro.en: The union-find parent links track connected groups, not the actual cable routes.
intro.zh: 并查集父链接追踪连通分组，不是真实电缆路线。

questions.code:
vertices = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
edges = [(1, "A", "B"), (2, "B", "C"), (4, "A", "C"),
         (3, "C", "D"), (6, "B", "D")]
parent = {v: v for v in vertices}
size = {v: 1 for v in vertices}
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x
chosen = []
total = 0
for weight, u, v in sorted(edges):
    a, b = find(u), find(v)
    if a == b:
        continue
    if size[a] < size[b]:
        a, b = b, a
    parent[b] = a
    size[a] += size[b]
    chosen.append((u, v, weight))
    total += weight
print("edges:", chosen)
print("total:", total)

en: Create one parent and size record per vertex before sorting edges.
Find endpoint representatives and skip edges already internal to a component.
Join the smaller component to the larger, recording the accepted graph edge separately.
zh: 排序边前为每顶点建立父与大小记录。
查端点代表，跳过分量内部边。
把小组合并到大组，另行记录接受的真实图边。

title.en: Grow a minimum spanning tree across a cut

intro.en: Prim chooses the cheapest crossing edge; it does not add a source distance.
intro.zh: Prim 选择最便宜的跨割边，不加上从源点出发的距离。

questions.code:
import heapq
graph = {"A": [("B", 1), ("C", 4)], "B": [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 6)],
         "C": [("A", 4), ("B", 2), ("D", 3)], "D": [("B", 6), ("C", 3)]}
visited = {"A"}
heap = [(w, "A", v) for v, w in graph["A"]]
heapq.heapify(heap)
chosen = []
total = 0
while heap:
    weight, u, v = heapq.heappop(heap)
    if v in visited:
        continue
    visited.add(v)
    chosen.append((u, v, weight))
    total += weight
    for neighbor, cost in graph[v]:
        if neighbor not in visited:
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cost, v, neighbor))
print("edges:", chosen)
print("total:", total)
print("spans graph:", len(visited) == len(graph))

en: Begin with A and place all edges leaving A into a min-heap.
Accept a cheapest edge only if it reaches a new vertex.
Add the new boundary edges, skip obsolete entries, and total accepted weights.
zh: 从 A 开始，把离开 A 的边放进小顶堆。
仅在最便宜边到达新顶点时接受它。
加入新的边界边，跳过旧项，累计所选边权。

title.en: Fill a capacity by density

intro.en: Treat value as an abstract usefulness score. The inputs have positive weights and divisible contents.
intro.zh: 价值表示抽象实用积分，输入重量正且内容可拆分。

questions.code:
items = [("A", 4, 28), ("B", 5, 25), ("C", 6, 18)]
remaining = 10
total = 0.0
for name, weight, value in sorted(items, key=lambda item: item[2] / item[1], reverse=True):
    taken_weight = min(weight, remaining)
    fraction = taken_weight / weight
    total += fraction * value
    remaining -= taken_weight
    print(name, "weight:", taken_weight, "fraction:", round(fraction, 3))
    if remaining == 0:
        break
print("total value:", total)
questions.output:
A weight: 4 fraction: 1.0
B weight: 5 fraction: 1.0
C weight: 1 fraction: 0.167
total value: 56.0

en: Sort by value divided by weight rather than either quantity alone.
Take the smaller of full item weight and remaining capacity.
Scale value by the taken fraction and stop exactly when capacity reaches zero.
zh: 按价值除重量排序，不只看其中一项。
取整件重与剩余容量中较小者。
按比例计价值，容量到零就停止。

title.en: Check where a greedy proof stops working
title.zh: 检查贪心证明在哪里失效

intro.en: Enumerate all eight subsets of three indivisible items and compare with density-first choice.
intro.zh: 枚举三个不可分物品的八个子集，与密度优先选择比较。

questions.code:
from itertools import product
items = [("A", 3, 5), ("B", 2, 3), ("C", 2, 3)]
capacity = 4
remaining = capacity
greedy = []
for name, weight, value in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x[2] / x[1], reverse=True):
    if weight <= remaining:
        greedy.append(name)
        remaining -= weight
best_value = -1
best_names = []
for mask in product([0, 1], repeat=len(items)):
    weight = sum(take * item[1] for take, item in zip(mask, items))
    value = sum(take * item[2] for take, item in zip(mask, items))
    if weight <= capacity and value > best_value:
        best_value = value
        best_names = [item[0] for take, item in zip(mask, items) if take]
print("density choice:", greedy)
print("best whole items:", best_names)
print("best value:", best_value)
questions.output:
density choice: ['A']
best whole items: ['B', 'C']
best value: 6

en: Run the density rule while requiring every selected item to fit completely.
Enumerate binary inclusion masks and compute each total weight and value.
Keep the best feasible subset and compare its value with the greedy choice.
zh: 运行密度规则，但要求选中的物品完整放入。
枚举二进制选择掩码，计算每个子集总重量和价值。
保留最佳可行子集，并与贪心结果比较。

title.en: When greedy fails: pack whole science kits
title.zh: 贪心失效时：装入不可拆分的科学套件

intro.en: Mina can carry four units of weight to a science fair. Kit A weighs three units and helps five visitors. Kits B and C each weigh two and help three. A has the best value per weight, so a density rule selects it first. Nothing else fits. Mina then tries B and C together and helps six visitors. The kits cannot be cut in half. She needs a method that compares complete choices, not a rule proved only for divisible items.
intro.zh: 米娜去科学展，只能携带四单位重量。A 套件重三单位，能帮助五位访客；B、C 各重两单位，各帮助三位。A 的价值密度最高，按密度贪心会先选 A，之后什么也装不下。米娜改选 B 和 C，却能帮助六位。套件不能切开，因此她需要比较完整选择，不能套用只对可分割物品成立的规则。

questions.output:
first 0 kits: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
first 1 kits: [0, 0, 0, 5, 5]
first 2 kits: [0, 0, 3, 5, 5]
first 3 kits: [0, 0, 3, 5, 6]
selected: ['B', 'C'] value: 6

en: Define a state before a loop: best[i][c] is the best value using only the first i items and capacity c.
Compare skipping item i with taking it once. Both branches read row i-1, so the same item cannot be reused.
Fill small prefixes before larger prefixes. Each dependency is already available.
Walk backward through changed rows to recover actual choices. Ties deliberately keep the skip branch.
zh: 先定义状态，再写循环：best[i][c] 表示只用前 i 件物品、容量为 c 时的最大价值。
比较跳过第 i 件与拿取一次两种方案。两分支都读取第 i-1 行，避免重复拿同一物品。
先填较短物品前缀，再填较长前缀，依赖的状态已经计算完。
倒着检查哪些行提升了结果，恢复具体选择。平局时明确采用跳过分支。

title.en: Assign every session to a room

intro.en: Heap entries store finish time followed by room number. The room number breaks equal-time ties deterministically.
intro.zh: 堆项保存结束时间和房间号，房间号让相同时间的选择确定。

questions.code:
import heapq
sessions = [(1, 4, "A"), (2, 5, "B"), (4, 6, "C"), (5, 7, "D")]
heap = []
rooms = 0
for start, finish, name in sorted(sessions):
    if heap and heap[0][0] <= start:
        _, room = heapq.heappop(heap)
    else:
        rooms += 1
        room = rooms
    heapq.heappush(heap, (finish, room))
    print(name, "room", room)
print("rooms:", rooms)
questions.output:
A room 1
B room 2
C room 1
D room 2
rooms: 2

en: Process sessions in increasing start time.
Reuse the earliest-finishing room when finish≤start; otherwise allocate one.
Replace that room’s finish entry and record every session’s assignment.
zh: 结束≤开始时复用最早房，否则分配新房。
替换该房结束项，记录每个场次分配。

title.en: Independently certify the room lower bound

intro.en: A sweep counts active half-open sessions. End events come before start events at a tie.
intro.zh: 扫描线统计活跃的半开区间。同一时刻先处理结束，再处理开始。

questions.code:
sessions = [(1, 4), (2, 5), (4, 6), (5, 7)]
events = []
for start, finish in sessions:
    events.append((start, 1))
    events.append((finish, -1))
active = depth = 0
for time, change in sorted(events):
    active += change
    depth = max(depth, active)
    print(time, change, active)
print("minimum rooms:", depth)

en: Create one start and one finish event for every session.
Sort so finishes are handled first at shared times.
Maintain the active count and its maximum as a lower-bound certificate.
zh: 为每个场次创建一个开始和一个结束事件。
排序并让同一时刻的结束事件先处理。
维护活跃数及其最大值，作为下界证明。

title.en: Build the tree and read its codewords
title.zh: 建立编码树并读取码字

intro.en: This example has four positive-frequency symbols. A serial number keeps heap ties independent of node contents.
intro.zh: 四个正频符号，序号使堆并列处理不依赖节点内容。

questions.code:
import heapq
from itertools import count
frequencies = {"A": 12, "B": 7, "C": 4, "D": 2}
serial = count()
heap = [(freq, next(serial), (symbol, None, None))
        for symbol, freq in frequencies.items()]
heapq.heapify(heap)
merges = []
while len(heap) > 1:
    a, _, left = heapq.heappop(heap)
    b, _, right = heapq.heappop(heap)
    merges.append(a + b)
    heapq.heappush(heap, (a + b, next(serial), (None, left, right)))
codes = {}
def walk(node, prefix):
    symbol, left, right = node
    if symbol is not None:
        codes[symbol] = prefix
        return
    walk(left, prefix + "0")
    walk(right, prefix + "1")
walk(heap[0][2], "")
for symbol in sorted(codes):
    print(symbol, codes[symbol])
print("merges:", merges)
print("bits:", sum(frequencies[s] * len(codes[s]) for s in codes))

en: Give leaves frequency priorities and unique serial numbers.
Merge the two minimum trees until only the full code tree remains.
Walk left with 0 and right with 1, then multiply code lengths by frequencies.
zh: 给叶子频率优先级与唯一序号。
反复合并最小两树，直到只剩完整码树。
左走加 0、右走加 1，再将码长乘频率。

title.en: Decode by waiting for a complete codeword
title.zh: 等待完整码字后再解码

intro.en: Use one valid codebook from the chapter; a leftover suffix is an incomplete message.
intro.zh: 使用本章的一个有效码本；剩余后缀表示消息尚不完整。

questions.output:
encoded: 010110111
decoded: ABCD
rejected: incomplete codeword

en: Invert the trusted prefix codebook and concatenate codes to encode ABCD.
Read one bit at a time, emitting only complete codewords.
Check that no unfinished suffix remains after the final bit.
zh: 反转可信前缀码本，再拼接码字编码 ABCD。
逐位读取，只在码字完整时输出符号。
最后一位后检查是否仍有未完成后缀。

title.en: Implement merge sort from its stopping case
title.zh: 从停止情形实现归并排序

intro.en: The program compares and moves values itself. It never asks sort or sorted to solve the algorithm.
intro.zh: 程序自己比较和移动，不借 sort 或 sorted 完成算法。

questions.code:
def merge_sort(values):
    if len(values) <= 1:
        return values.copy()
    middle = len(values) // 2
    left = merge_sort(values[:middle])
    right = merge_sort(values[middle:])
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result
print(merge_sort([8, 3, 7, 1]))
print(merge_sort([]))
print(merge_sort([4, 2, 4]))

en: Stop at zero or one item; otherwise split into nearly equal halves.
Merge sorted child results by advancing only the chosen front pointer.
Append the unused tail and return the complete sorted sequence.
zh: 零或一项停止，否则近乎均分。
合并有序孩子结果，只前进被选前端指针。
追加未用尾部，返回完整有序序列。

title.en: Halve a search interval without copying data
title.zh: 不用复制地把搜索区间减半

intro.en: The low and high indices include both ends of the remaining search interval.
intro.zh: low、high 都包含在当前搜索区间内。

questions.code:
values = [2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38]
target = 16
low, high = 0, len(values) - 1
checked = []
found = -1
while low <= high:
    middle = (low + high) // 2
    checked.append(values[middle])
    if values[middle] == target:
        found = middle
        break
    if values[middle] < target:
        low = middle + 1
    else:
        high = middle - 1
print("checked:", checked)
print("index:", found)

en: Initialize inclusive boundaries around the entire sorted array.
Compare the midpoint and exclude it together with the impossible half.
Stop on equality or an empty interval and retain the original array indices.
zh: 以包含两端的边界包围整个已排序数组。
比较中点，将它和不可能的一半排除。
相等或区间空时停止，始终保留原数组索引。

title.en: Partition and recursively sort both sides

intro.en: This simple fixed-pivot version shows the mechanism and handles repeated values explicitly.
intro.zh: 固定枢轴简版展示机制，并明确处理重复值。

en: Use the first value as pivot and distribute every copy into one of three lists.
Recursively sort only the strictly smaller and strictly larger lists.
Join sorted lower values, the whole equal block, and sorted higher values.
zh: 首值作枢轴，把每个副本分到三个表之一。
仅递归严格小于和严格大于的表。
拼接有序小值、完整相等块、有序大值。
小于 / 等于 / 大于

title.en: Partition inside one array

intro.en: An explicit stack replaces recursion; the last value is the pivot.
intro.zh: 显式栈代替递归；每段最后一个值作为枢轴。

questions.code:
values = [4, 1, 3, 2]
stack = [(0, len(values) - 1)]
while stack:
    low, high = stack.pop()
    if low >= high:
        continue
    pivot = values[high]
    boundary = low
    for scan in range(low, high):
        if values[scan] <= pivot:
            values[boundary], values[scan] = values[scan], values[boundary]
            boundary += 1
    values[boundary], values[high] = values[high], values[boundary]
    print("pivot:", pivot, "index:", boundary, "state:", values)
    stack.append((boundary + 1, high))
    stack.append((low, boundary - 1))
print("sorted:", values)
questions.output:
pivot: 2 index: 1 state: [1, 2, 3, 4]
pivot: 4 index: 3 state: [1, 2, 3, 4]
sorted: [1, 2, 3, 4]

en: Pop an inclusive interval; skip empty or one-item intervals.
Grow a region of values no larger than the pivot using boundary and scan.
Place the pivot, then schedule both strictly smaller intervals.
zh: 取出包含两端的区间，跳过空段或单元素段。
用 boundary 和 scan 扩展不大于枢轴的区域。
安放枢轴，再把两侧更短区间加入待处理栈。

title.en: Keep points that improve the best second score
title.zh: 保留改善第二指标的点

intro.en: Sorting by both coordinates handles equal first coordinates. This version keeps one representative of duplicate coordinate pairs.
intro.zh: 按两坐标排序处理相等第一坐标；重复坐标对只保留一个代表。

questions.code:
points = [("A", 1, 8), ("B", 3, 5), ("C", 4, 7),
          ("D", 6, 4), ("E", 7, 2)]
ordered = sorted(points, key=lambda p: (p[1], p[2]), reverse=True)
best_y = float("-inf")
frontier = []
for name, x, y in ordered:
    if y > best_y:
        frontier.append(name)
        best_y = y
    print(name, "best y:", best_y)
print("frontier:", frontier)
questions.output:
E best y: 2
D best y: 4
C best y: 7
B best y: 7
A best y: 8
frontier: ['E', 'D', 'C', 'A']

en: Sort descending by x and then y so potential dominators appear first.
Maintain the largest y seen, keeping only strict improvements.
Record skipped B’s witness C and retain the remaining tradeoffs.
zh: 先 x 后 y 降序，让潜在支配者先出现。
维护已见最大 y，仅保留严格改善。
记录丢弃 B 的见证 C，保留其余取舍。

title.en: Check ties with the dominance definition
title.zh: 按支配定义检查并列点

intro.en: A quadratic reference algorithm keeps distinct records at identical coordinates.
intro.zh: 一个二次时间的参考算法保留坐标相同但记录不同的点。

questions.output:
frontier: ['A', 'B', 'D']
A dominates B: False
A dominates C: True

en: Implement weak comparison in both dimensions and strict comparison in at least one.
For each candidate, search for one witness that dominates it.
Retain candidates with no witness, including identical-coordinate records.
zh: 两维都用非严格比较，并要求至少一维严格更好。
为每个候选寻找一个能支配它的见证点。
保留没有支配见证的候选，包括同坐标记录。

title.en: Multiply using three recursive products

intro.en: This small decimal implementation accepts nonnegative integers and exposes the decomposition.
intro.zh: 小型十进制实现接收非负整数，展示拆分过程。

questions.code:
def karatsuba(x, y):
    if x < 10 or y < 10:
        return x * y
    digits = max(len(str(x)), len(str(y)))
    base = 10 ** (digits // 2)
    high_x, low_x = divmod(x, base)
    high_y, low_y = divmod(y, base)
    high_product = karatsuba(high_x, high_y)
    low_product = karatsuba(low_x, low_y)
    combined = karatsuba(high_x + low_x, high_y + low_y)
    cross = combined - high_product - low_product
    return high_product * base * base + cross * base + low_product
print(karatsuba(23, 47))
print(karatsuba(1234, 5678))
print(karatsuba(0, 900))

en: Stop when either factor has one decimal digit; otherwise split both at a common base.
Compute high product, low product and product of sums with three recursive calls.
Subtract to recover the cross sum and restore each decimal place.
zh: 任一因子个位数就停止，否则用共同基数拆两数。
用三个递归调用算高乘积、低乘积、和的乘积。
减法恢复交叉和，再恢复每项十进制位值。

title.en: See the four products Karatsuba avoids
title.zh: 观察普通乘法的四个乘积

intro.en: Multiply two two-digit integers by place value, retaining all four cross-products.
intro.zh: 按位值乘两个两位整数，保留全部四个部分乘积。

questions.code:
x, y = 23, 47
high_x, low_x = divmod(x, 10)
high_y, low_y = divmod(y, 10)
parts = [("high-high", high_x * high_y, 100),
         ("high-low", high_x * low_y, 10),
         ("low-high", low_x * high_y, 10),
         ("low-low", low_x * low_y, 1)]
result = 0
for name, product, place in parts:
    result += product * place
    print(name, product, "place:", place, "running:", result)
print("product:", result)
print("ordinary leaves at depth 3:", 4 ** 3)
print("Karatsuba leaves at depth 3:", 3 ** 3)

high-low 14 place: 10 running: 940
low-high 12 place: 10 running: 1060
low-low 21 place: 1 running: 1081
product: 1081

Karatsuba leaves at depth 3: 27

en: Split 23 and 47 into their tens and units with divmod.
Multiply each pair of parts and restore its decimal place.
Compare recursive leaf counts while keeping combination work separate.
zh: 用 divmod 把 23、47 分成十位和个位。
计算每对部分的乘积并恢复十进制位值。
比较递归叶子数，并把合并工作另行考虑。

title.en: Find a rank without sorting both sides
title.zh: 无需排序两侧就找到秩

intro.en: The code uses a fixed middle-index pivot so its trace is repeatable. It demonstrates selection, not the random-pivot expected-time guarantee.
intro.zh: 代码用固定中间索引枢轴以保证追踪可复现，演示选择而非随机枢轴期望保证。

en: Validate that the one-based rank lies within the current request.
Partition around the middle-index value, which need not be the median.
Keep one side and adjust rank, or return immediately from the equal block.
zh: 检查从一开始的秩在请求范围内。
围绕中间索引值分区，它不一定是中位数。
只留一侧并调整秩，或在相等块立即返回。

title.en: Choose a pivot from small-group medians
title.zh: 从小组中位数选择枢轴

intro.en: Sort only groups of at most five. Do not sort the full input to answer a rank query.
intro.zh: 只排序至多五个元素的小组，不通过全排序回答秩查询。

en: Reduce groups of at most five to their medians, then select a middle median.
Count lower, equal and higher blocks around that pivot.
Return inside the equal block or adjust rank before following one outer block.
zh: 把至多五个元素的小组归约为中位数，再选择中间的中位数。
统计枢轴周围的小于、等于和大于块。
若目标在相等块则返回，否则调整秩并只进入一侧。

title.en: Check every shuffle path for three cards
title.zh: 检查三张牌的全部洗牌路径

intro.en: Instead of relying on a seed, enumerate every possible Fisher–Yates choice sequence. This makes the output exact and repeatable.
intro.zh: 不依赖种子，枚举全部 Fisher–Yates 选择序列，使输出精确且可复现。

questions.code:
from itertools import product
from collections import Counter
outcomes = Counter()
for choices in product(range(3), range(2)):
    cards = ["A", "B", "C"]
    for i, j in zip([2, 1], choices):
        cards[i], cards[j] = cards[j], cards[i]
    outcomes["".join(cards)] += 1
for order in sorted(outcomes):
    print(order, outcomes[order])
print("paths:", sum(outcomes.values()))

ABC 1
ACB 1
BAC 1
BCA 1
CAB 1
CBA 1
paths: 6

en: Enumerate the three choices for position 2 and two choices for position 1.
Start a fresh card list for every path and apply its two swaps.
Count final permutations and print them in sorted order for deterministic output.
zh: 枚举位置 2 的三选与位置 1 的二选。
每条路径从新卡表开始，执行两次交换。
统计最终排列并按排序次序打印，保证输出确定。

title.en: Expose a nearly plausible biased shuffle
title.zh: 揭示看似合理的有偏洗牌

intro.en: Swap every position with any of three positions. Enumerate its 27 equally likely choice paths.
intro.zh: 每个位置都与三个位置中的任一个交换，枚举其 27 条等概率选择路径。

questions.code:
from itertools import product
from collections import Counter
outcomes = Counter()
for choices in product(range(3), repeat=3):
    cards = ["A", "B", "C"]
    for i, j in enumerate(choices):
        cards[i], cards[j] = cards[j], cards[i]
    outcomes["".join(cards)] += 1
for order in sorted(outcomes):
    print(order, outcomes[order])
print("paths:", sum(outcomes.values()))
print("equal frequencies:", len(set(outcomes.values())) == 1)

ACB 5
BAC 5
BCA 5
CAB 4
CBA 4
